Function Documentation

int terminal_format_hyperlink (char * buffer, size_t capacity, const char * url, const char * label, bool enabled)

Format a clickable, underlined OSC 8 terminal link. Uses the same terminal protocol on Windows, macOS, and Linux. The terminal emulator handles clicking and opening the URL in the user's browser. Emulators without OSC 8 support still display the label. Pass enabled=false for plain output. Styling and the hyperlink end immediately after the label. URLs and labels must not contain terminal control characters.

Returns

Number of bytes written, or -1 for invalid input/insufficient space. On failure a nonempty output buffer is cleared; escape sequences are never truncated. The return count excludes the terminating NUL.
